title: Graph
statementMd:
Given a simple undirected connected graph $G$ with $n$ vertices and $m$ edges, you need to choose two distinct edges to delete, obtaining a new graph $G'$, such that $G'$ remains connected.

Let the two deleted edges be $(p,q)$ and $(u,v)$. You need to minimize the sum of the shortest path between $p$ and $q$ in $G'$ plus the shortest path between $u$ and $v$ in $G'$. Output this minimum value and the number of deletion schemes that achieve it.

## Input

This problem has multiple test cases.

The first line contains an integer $T$ — the number of test cases.

For each test case:

The first line contains two integers $n,m$.

The next $m$ lines each contain two integers $u,v$, representing an edge.

The graph has no multi-edges or self-loops. It is guaranteed that at least one deletion scheme exists such that the graph remains connected.

$1\le T\le 5000$, $1\le \sum n,\sum m \le 5000$, $4\le n$, $5\le m$.

## Output

For each test case:

Output a single line with two integers — the minimum value and the number of schemes.
statementZhMd:
给定一个具有 $n$ 个顶点和 $m$ 条边的简单无向连通图 $G$，你需要选择两条不同的边并将其删除，得到新图 $G'$，使得 $G'$ 仍然保持连通。

设删除的两条边分别为 $(p,q)$ 和 $(u,v)$。你需要最小化在 $G'$ 中 $p$ 与 $q$ 之间的最短路径长度，加上 $u$ 与 $v$ 之间的最短路径长度。输出这个最小值，以及达到该最小值的删除方案数量。

## 输入格式

本题包含多组测试数据。

第一行包含一个整数 $T$，表示测试数据组数。

对于每组测试数据：

第一行包含两个整数 $n,m$。

接下来的 $m$ 行中，每行包含两个整数 $u,v$，表示一条边。

图中不存在重边或自环。保证至少存在一种删除方案，使得删除后图仍然保持连通。

$1\le T\le 5000$，$1\le \sum n,\sum m\le 5000$，$4\le n$，$5\le m$。

## 输出格式

对于每组测试数据：

输出一行，包含两个整数，分别表示最小值和方案数量。
